comments.label: Comment by Ashraful Haque Mahfuze 12 years ago
comments.text:
ECO372, ECO430 will go well with finance ... ECO430 is more or less FIN444 ...
I would suggest you take ECO317, ECO380, ECO417 (The last two are not offered this semester I think) ...
and from your list ECO485 is not offered this semester as well ... I don't think it will be offered any time soon
ECO372 is a pre-requisite for ECO472 so you won't be able to take that ... and ECO474 is pretty difficult I heard ... if you can manage it will not be related to finance that much but it WILL carry a lot of weight on your transcript when and if you go for higher education ... I took it this semester as well .. Let's hope for the best
Hope I have been of some help
